initial note: This office replaces Nocturn today. It is sung in front of the Shroud, before Easter Matins, in somber vestments.

final note.0: Troparion of the Holy Saturday (below) is sung thrice with prostrations. The Shroud is then removed, and preparations are made to celebrate Easter Matins.
final note.1: Troparion of the Holy Saturday (below) is sung with prostrations: first by the clergy, then by the faithful, then half by the clergy, and half by the faithful. Then the Shroud is venerated, only by the clergy. It is then removed, and preparations are made to celebrate Easter Matins.
